population: Public itch.io paid-game seller configuration and buyer-entitlement policies; not all transactions, countries or merchants
unit: Source-defined sale rule, refund condition or payment-currency mode, not an actual paid order
period: Official Terms last noted April 2023; creator help documents available 2026-10-27
sample_frame: First-party creator sale, pricing, payments, quality guidance and platform terms
research_implications: For a price experiment, keep same game, time window, viewer source, pre-discount base price, browser/download entitlement and refund state aligned; do not treat badge visibility as causal revenue uplift.
Separately tag full-price orders, discounted positive payments, 100%-discount free acquisitions, pay-what-you-want tips, bundle shares and refunded payments.
Preserve both buyer gross payments and final settled seller proceeds with processor, tax, withholding and FX deductions separately.
Do not equate direct-selling currency selection or buyer-location VAT handling with verified per-country discretionary base-price automation.
An ownership record from a previous base-priced purchase does not necessarily grant later access to more expensive individually priced assets.
Seller-country and processor eligibility, actual refund ratios and geographic paid-order cohorts need independent consented transaction evidence.
limitations: Official policy and creator help are evidence for rules, not actual seller outcomes.
Provider currency examples are verbatim scope-limited platform guidance at retrieval, not guaranteed every country corridor or the world's current FX settlement terms.

Terms refer to geographically applicable purchase prices, but the reviewed official creator documentation does not establish a platform-wide automated differential base-price selector; that feature remains unknown.
No real account, payments, private buyer identity, purchases, refunds or merchant eligibility were tested.
